fields.summary: With the queue running one change set at a time (each regenerates describe-golden), the orchestrator picked work for the idle daemon slot that changes no request type: the older proposed change set 01M5SWTFB3, what-if reads under the 50 ms read budget. Milestone 15's what-if change cut the 50k-node what-if show from about 1,620 ms to about 240 ms by folding only the in-flight change sets over the stored as-is rows, but it still builds a full in-memory model of the whole as-is (about 110 ms on the profile before, the rest now), and TestReadBudget times only as-is and to-be reads. Meeting the budget needs the reader to answer from the index's stored as-is rows with an overlay of only the records the change set and its closure touch or create, rather than a full model.
fields.title: Milestone 20: what-if reads meet the budget
